assets.caption: Fig. 1400-18 Richmond Refinery Emission Rate Data for LEV Performance in Block Valves (1994 Data)
assets.notes: Logarithmic bar chart. Y-axis: Emission Rate (lb/yr), log scale 0.01 to 100. X-axis: four valve types (Slade 3300G, Garlock #70, Garlock EVSP, Graphaseal). Three series: Initial Readings (white/hatched), After Repair Attempts (dark gray), PERF 90-05 Data (light gray). Reference lines at 500 ppm and 100 ppm shown on the y-axis.
